plan_claim_vs_archive: plan v2.0 row 1 claims '3,849 images, 9 cultivars, 3 grades' and an '8 cultivars known + 1 held out' arm. The figshare record (v1 and v2, same 8,838,332,680-byte zip) and the archive itself state 1,245 images, 3,493 boxes, 3 stages, and contain NO cultivar field or folder. Cultivar-level P2 is therefore not buildable from this source; it is recorded as unavailable rather than approximated.
